Hi Jamal, I found your record. It shows a 2014 F-150 with a gas engine, so we can work on it.

I can't tell you if it's the catalytic converter. P0420 means the truck's computer thinks the converter isn't working as well as it should. But other problems can set the same code, like a bad oxygen sensor or an exhaust leak, and some of those cost a lot less to fix. We don't diagnose over chat or phone. A technician has to see the truck. For the same reason I can't give you a repair price yet.

Here's what we can do. A check engine diagnosis takes about an hour and costs $125. Once Andre knows what's wrong, we'll give you a written estimate. We won't do any repairs until you approve them.

Tomorrow (Wednesday, Oct. 14), Andre Simmons, our master technician, is open every half hour from 7:30 a.m. until 1:00 p.m. What time works for you? Tell me and I'll book it.
